units.source_text: “如果这个新恋人，有旧恋人的一半强的话……”

en.t: If this new lover were even half as strong as the old one...

units.source_text: 町子想用这样的语言拒绝他，

en.t: Machiko wanted to refuse him with words like these,

units.source_text: 她一边想年少的新恋人会明白吗，

en.t: wondering as she did whether her young new lover would understand,

units.source_text: 一边从铁楼梯爬到了屋顶上。

en.t: while she climbed the iron stairs up to the roof.
